name: Rotigotine
mechanism: Non-ergot dopamine agonist delivered transdermally providing continuous dopaminergic stimulation
dosing: Patch 2 mg/24h, titrate weekly based on response (range commonly 2-8 mg/24h)
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to rotigotine or patch components
interactions: Other dopaminergic agents (additive effects), dopaminergic antagonists may reduce efficacy
monitoring: Skin site reactions, impulse control disorders, orthostatic symptoms, neuropsychiatric effects
sideEffects: Nausea, somnolence, dizziness, application site reactions, hallucinations, orthostatic hypotension
pharmacokinetics: Transdermal delivery with continuous plasma concentrations
clinicalPearls: Useful for early Parkinson's disease or when oral therapy is difficult; avoid sudden patch removal without medical review.
indication: Parkinson's disease (monotherapy or adjunct via transdermal patch)
